title.zh: UK names 6 banks to lead first digitally native government bond
title.en: UK names 6 banks to lead first digitally native government bond

current_state.zh: The UK appointed six banks — Barclays, HSBC, Lloyds, Morgan Stanley, NatWest and RBC Capital Markets — as joint lead managers for its first digitally native government bond (DIGIT), a Digital Securities Sandbox pilot testing DLT issuance and onchain settlement of UK sovereign debt with issuance targeted for Q1 2027.
current_state.en: The UK appointed six banks — Barclays, HSBC, Lloyds, Morgan Stanley, NatWest and RBC Capital Markets — as joint lead managers for its first digitally native government bond (DIGIT), a Digital Securities Sandbox pilot testing DLT issuance and onchain settlement of UK sovereign debt with issuance targeted for Q1 2027.
